faqs.question: What is a Marking Order?
faqs.answer: A Marking Order is an official service of the Forest and Environment Department, Government of Sikkim, providing citizens with a common entry point to request tree marking for tree felling in accordance with applicable departmental procedures.

faqs.question: Which department handles Marking Order applications?
faqs.answer: Marking Order applications are handled by the Forest and Environment Department, Government of Sikkim.

faqs.question: Who can apply for a Marking Order?
faqs.answer: Citizens seeking a Marking Order for tree felling in Sikkim may apply through this service. Eligibility details are subject to departmental confirmation. Please refer to the official departmental guidelines or contact the department for confirmation.

faqs.question: What documents are required?
faqs.answer: Applicants must provide the supporting documents prescribed by the Forest and Environment Department. Required document details are pending departmental confirmation. Please refer to the official departmental guidelines or contact the department for confirmation.

faqs.question: How can I apply for a Marking Order?
faqs.answer: You can apply by reviewing the service overview on this page, logging in via Sikkim GO (https://sso.sikkim.gov.in/), accessing the Marking Order application, completing the required application and supporting information, and submitting your request online.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee?
faqs.answer: Applicable fee and payment requirements for the Marking Order service are pending departmental confirmation. Please refer to the official departmental guidelines or contact the department for confirmation.

faqs.question: How can I track my application?
faqs.answer: Applicants will be able to monitor the progress of their submitted Marking Order request online after logging in through Sikkim GO once application tracking is configured. Please refer to the official departmental guidelines or contact the department for confirmation.

faqs.question: How can I contact the Forest and Environment Department?
faqs.answer: Citizens may contact the Forest and Environment Department at the Forest Secretariat, Deorali, Gangtok, Sikkim, or reach out to their respective District Helpdesk. Specific helpline telephone numbers and email addresses are pending departmental confirmation. Please refer to the official departmental guidelines or contact the department for confirmation.
